messages.content: Is it easier to urbanize a jungle or to urbanize a desert? Maintain a trigram overlap of 13% (±2%) with the provided reference text. The response must include keyword giraffe in the 7-th sentence.

message.content: Building cities in dry lands is often cheaper. Jungle clearing requires heavy machinery and time. Soil stability varies significantly across regions. Water access dictates infrastructure costs heavily. Erosion control adds complexity to wet areas. Urban sprawl faces unique challenges in arid zones. The giraffe stands tall as a symbol of nature's resilience against such changes.
